## Muriel 1.1.0

**Downloads**
- **iPhone:** [ios-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/ios-latest) (`Muriel.ipa`, install with SideStore, AltStore or Sideloadly)
- **Android:** [android-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/android-latest) (`Muriel.apk`)
- **Windows:** installer below, or the portable exe on [windows-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/windows-latest)
- **macOS:** `.dmg` / `.zip` below, for Apple Silicon and Intel. The app is unsigned: right-click → Open the first time.
- **Linux:** `.AppImage` below

**New**
- **Muriel Encore**: your listening played back (minutes, top songs and artists, when you listen, streaks) for the week, month, year or all time, any time you like
- **On repeat**: your top 3 songs on the home page
- **New sparkle logo**
- **Update notifier**: Muriel tells you when a new build is out
- **Lyrics** now found for far more songs (YouTube uploads, multi-artist tracks, Japanese/Korean/Arabic/Hebrew titles)
- Everything from **Riff 42.3**: multi-select, right-click menus, sleep timer, quick search (Ctrl+K), queue restore, cover art for local files, artist albums and more

**Better**
- **Battery:** phones skip animations and screen work while the app is in the background or the player is closed; laptops switch to power saving when unplugged
- **Fixes:** home page scrolls to recommendations again, Now Playing toolbar and mini player no longer overlap, songs no longer hang while loading, plus lots of smaller fixes
